gates.title: Supported capacity and physical fault domains
gates.pass_condition: Declare and measure per-validator minimum RAM/CPU, peak RSS, replay headroom, and a stake/failure-domain mapping on independently provisioned hosts; demonstrate the claimed host-failure tolerance.
gates.fail_condition: An OOM/restart loop within the claimed supported tier, or one-host loss defeating the stated quorum fault model.
gates.observable: Measured per-validator RAM/CPU/peak RSS/replay headroom; stake per independent failure domain; the one-host-loss quorum calculation.
gates.negative_control: One-host loss must defeat the claimed quorum; a below-minimum 1 GiB injection is not supported-tier acceptance; a declared tier contradicted by a 24 GB replay must fail, and --allow-under-minimum is not a pass.
gates.status_reason: No declared supported tier or independently provisioned host/stake map. The resource-safety witness counts rnode processes only; it does not measure capacity or fault domains.

related.criterion: the installed candidate pins are a prerequisite for measuring its tier

gates.does_not_claim: A 1 GiB fault injection is a diagnosability probe, not supported-tier acceptance.

gates.title: Bounded public ingress and overload behavior
gates.pass_condition: Verify independently, at HTTP, direct HTTP and gRPC: concurrent requests, memory/byte/term budgets, bounded queues, explicit backpressure, and deterministic acceptance/rejection.
gates.fail_condition: Silent accepted-write loss, unbounded work or queues, ambiguous acceptance, or uncontrolled memory pressure inside the accepted envelope.
gates.observable: Accepted/rejected counts and queue depth under HTTP/direct/gRPC load; a backpressure signal; no silent accepted-work loss.
gates.negative_control: Remove a queue bound and require the source-shape gate to fail; a load arm must show an explicit rejection, not a silent drop; the default configuration (in-flight limit unset) must not pass; a new refusal class outside the closed vocabulary must not be reported as 400.
gates.status_reason: Source-shape queue bounds and the C105 backpressure work exist; no installed-candidate pressure acceptance across HTTP, direct HTTP and gRPC.

related.criterion: bounded production is a prerequisite for the deploy-finalises witness

gates.does_not_claim: A source-shape queue bound is not a pressure test.

gates.title: Off-host bootstrap and fringe completion
gates.pass_condition: An external observer advertises a routable peer address, authenticates and joins, receives and applies the approved fringe, and hydrates state. Negative control: 127.0.0.1 advertised from another host must fail clearly. Test alternative-peer failover separately.
gates.fail_condition: A claim based on a send log alone; an invalid observer address treated as a handler defect; a missing transport-delivery witness.
gates.observable: The correlation request -> receipt -> response construction -> transport completion -> requester receive -> state application, with peer address and identity; the loopback negative control.
gates.negative_control: A loopback address advertised from another host must fail clearly; a send-log-only claim must not pass; the responder's stream completion must be observable, and a 'sent' log alone must fail.
gates.status_reason: The historical #575 result is instrument PASS / join FAIL, retained; no fresh routable off-host receive/apply witness or failover.

related.criterion: the join subset (A2.2/A2.4) is a different criterion from off-host fringe delivery

gates.does_not_claim: Instrument or send-log PASS is not state application.

gates.title: Finality, liveness and autonomous recovery
gates.pass_condition: Named, independently rerunnable N=4 and N=8 workloads under adequate independent-host capacity: deploy finalization, partition/rejoin, host loss, restart/replay, and safe recovery without changing the approved root.
gates.fail_condition: A permanent wedge within the declared fault model, inability to rejoin, or a safety-invariant violation.
gates.observable: A deploy finalizes; a fixed finalized anchor is retained by every validator on a K-sample dwell; partition/rejoin, host loss, restart/replay, and the approved root unchanged.
gates.negative_control: Equal moving heads must not count as the criterion; a victim that never finalizes the fixed anchor must fail; a single-host bridge run below the supported tier must not pass.
gates.status_reason: N=4/N=8 has not run on the selected candidate. The historical 69bf868f pass is under the superseded equal-heads criterion; the standing criterion is anchor retention.

related.criterion: G4 is the restart/recovery arm only, not the full N=4/N=8 envelope
A1.3's N=8 finality failure is a finality/supermajority observation, not a separate campaign

gates.does_not_claim: A local partition drill or a green CI badge is not the N=4/N=8 release envelope.

gates.title: Finalized state integrity and merge accounting
gates.pass_condition: Recompute the #420 four-parent 840->841 merge from source-pinned event logs; record final_scope_rejected_chains, rejections_without_a_conflict, unapplied_kept_writes, and each accepted/rejected deploy effect. Add isolated sequential and parallel hot-cell regression.
gates.fail_condition: A finalized accepted effect disappears without a legitimate transition, or merge accounting cannot explain the witness.
gates.observable: MergeReport accounting fields; per-chain effect verdict; accepted/rejected deploy effects; sequential and parallel hot-cell regressions.
gates.negative_control: A fabricated missing effect must be rejected; a block with rejectedDeploys: [] does not establish an empty final-scope rejected-chain set; every kept datum/kont/native effect must be read back from the produced state.
gates.status_reason: The authenticated historical 840->841 bundle is UNAVAILABLE (owner decision 2026-11-15, comment 6892934659). M5-04/M5-06 component accounting is verified; it is not the historical M5 gate. Unavailability is a continuing blocker, not a waiver.

related.criterion: A:block-merge is an open semantic decision, not an M5 witness
sidecar-merge is cost composition, not per-chain accounting
the merge-diff row is one merge-accounting component

gates.does_not_claim: Component/hot-cell accounting is not the historical 840->841 replay; the unavailable bundle is not a pass.

gates.title: Reproducibility and independent sign-off
gates.pass_condition: Preserve binary/source SHA, host/config/stake/clock boundaries, hashes of protected log snapshots, deploy IDs, included/finalized block hashes, test commands, CI runs, raw outcomes, reviewer conclusions and explicit non-claims.
gates.fail_condition: Undocumented configuration, unsupported hardware inference, private-only unverifiable pass assertions, or missing provenance.
gates.observable: A reproducibility record with every pin, boundary, hash, command, raw outcome, reviewer conclusion and non-claim; the reviewer is independent and the record is digest-pinned.
gates.negative_control: A record missing a pin or a non-claim must fail; a pin that is not 40/64-hex must fail; a self-authored review must fail the independence rule.
gates.status_reason: No selected candidate reproducibility record or independent reviewer conclusion exists.

related.criterion: the #584 verdict is a live-run sign-off, not the full M6 reproducibility review
the section-6 category-A disposition is a separate audit sign-off
C357 acceptance is a narrow hardfork boundary, not M6

gates.does_not_claim: One sign-off does not discharge M6, G6, the section-6 audit and C357 together.

gates.title: Installed pins
gates.pass_condition: One selected source commit / artifact / executable SHA-256 installed on all four validators, with four distinct validator identities, and the genesis/bond set pinned. Pins collected per host by #572 and checked independently of the collector's own ok flag.
gates.fail_condition: A mixed or unverified installed set, a reused identity, an unpinned genesis/bond set, or a collector's own ok flag treated as independent evidence.
gates.observable: Per-host source/artifact/executable digests; four distinct validator identities; the pinned genesis/bond set.
gates.negative_control: A collector ok flag alone must not pass; a mismatched host digest must fail; four agreeing records that pin a non-selected binary must fail.
gates.status_reason: The installed candidate and preflight inputs are unfilled; #559 is a draft and #584 has not executed.

related.criterion: the selected candidate is an M1 prerequisite

gates.does_not_claim: The collector's ok flag is not an operational GO.

gates.title: Signed deploy lifecycle
gates.pass_condition: One signed native-REV transfer sampled at accepted -> pooled -> included -> finalized, with timestamped observations from each of the four validators and from the finality/settlement endpoints.
gates.fail_condition: A stage is missing, an observation is not timestamped, or a single route substitutes for the four observations.
gates.observable: The four-stage transfer with per-validator and endpoint observations and UTC timestamps.
gates.negative_control: A transfer that is accepted but never finalized must not pass.
gates.status_reason: The live run has not executed.
gates.does_not_claim: A local devnet transfer is not the live lifecycle.

gates.title: No false settlement
gates.pass_condition: Before finality the transfer reads not-finalized at every surface; acceptsDeploys is never reported as settlement; the finality endpoint agrees with the four observations.
gates.fail_condition: A pre-finality surface reads finalized, acceptsDeploys is reported as settlement, or the endpoint disagrees with the four observations.
gates.observable: Per-surface pre-finality status; acceptsDeploys semantics; endpoint agreement with the four observations.
gates.negative_control: A deploy that is accepted but not finalized must read not-finalized everywhere.
gates.status_reason: The live run has not executed.

related.criterion: finality is the criterion-1 witness; admission is not finality

gates.does_not_claim: Acceptance and inclusion are not settlement.

gates.title: Recovery without loss
gates.pass_condition: A restart (or the runbook's chosen recovery arm) finalizes the same deploy with no accepted work lost, and no spurious self-replay or own-key halt fires on a healthy key (post-#577/#578 behaviour).
gates.fail_condition: Accepted work is lost, or a spurious self-replay/own-key halt fires on a healthy key.
gates.observable: The same deploy finalized after the restart/recovery arm; no lost accepted work; no spurious halt.
gates.negative_control: A restart that loses the accepted deploy must fail; a healthy-key spurious halt must fail.
gates.status_reason: The planned single-validator restart arm has not executed.

related.criterion: G4 is the restart/recovery arm only; M4 is the full N=4/N=8 envelope

gates.does_not_claim: G4 recovery does not discharge the M4 partition/rejoin or host-loss criteria.

gates.title: Independent observations
gates.pass_condition: The verdict rests on four validator observations plus the endpoints, not on one public route. Raw responses, commands, digests and UTC times are retained under spec/audit/evidence/ with a SHA256SUMS file that verifies from a git archive.
gates.fail_condition: One route or one validator substitutes for the four; the raw observations or digests are not retained; SHA256SUMS does not verify.
gates.observable: Four validator observations plus endpoints; raw responses, commands, digests, UTC times; a verifying SHA256SUMS.
gates.negative_control: A single-route snapshot must not pass; a self-consistent fabricated run dir with arbitrary pin strings must fail.
gates.status_reason: The live run and retained evidence bundle do not exist.

related.criterion: G5 is the live-observation subset of the M6 reproducibility record

gates.does_not_claim: A public-route snapshot is not four independent observations.

gates.title: Independent verdict
gates.pass_condition: PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE recorded by the named independent reviewer against G1-G5, with the evidence record cited.
gates.fail_condition: No verdict, a verdict by a non-independent reviewer, or a verdict that does not cite the evidence.
gates.observable: The named reviewer's verdict, independence attestation, and the cited evidence record.
gates.negative_control: A self-authored verdict must fail; a free-text README with no typed reviewer record must fail; a FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE does not close the gate.
gates.status_reason: No verdict exists; the live run has not executed.

related.criterion: G6 is a subset of the M6 reproducibility and sign-off gate

gates.does_not_claim: G6 does not discharge M6 or the #51 audit sign-off.

gates.title: Anyone can propose, and production is bounded
gates.pass_condition: A deploy finalises (last-finalized-block >= its height), never 'the height stopped moving'.
gates.fail_condition: A deploy that is accepted or included but never finalizes under the declared conditions.
gates.observable: Finalized height >= the deploy height; the A1.1/A1.2/A1.4/A1.5 arms; A1.3 is the N=8 counterexample.
gates.negative_control: A moving tip alone must not pass; finality is the witness.
gates.status_reason: A1.3 (N=8) fails: the supporting stake is 400 of 800, not a supermajority. A1.2 (N=5) passes; A1.1/A1.4/A1.5 pass on the older tree.

related.criterion: A1.3 is a finality/supermajority component of the M4 envelope
finality is the settlement witness; admission is not settlement

gates.does_not_claim: A height trace or acceptsDeploys is not criterion 1.

gates.title: Validators can be dropped and joined without risk
gates.pass_condition: The survivors finalise past the kill; the rejoiner resumes with no operator action; a new validator bonds onto a running net and produces.
gates.fail_condition: The survivors stall at the kill, the rejoiner needs an operator action, or a new validator cannot bond and produce.
gates.observable: A post-kill deploy finalizes; the rejoiner resumes with start only; a new validator bonds and produces; the leave path pays out.
gates.negative_control: A send-log or a single-route observation must not pass.
gates.status_reason: The 5/5 arms are recorded on the older tree; the live re-run on the selected candidate has not happened.

related.criterion: the join subset (A2.2/A2.4) is not off-host fringe delivery

gates.does_not_claim: The join subset is not the whole criterion.

gates.title: Every attack vector is handled
gates.pass_condition: Not a pass/fail item: a rate and class census against the bounded-adversary statement in docs/src/spec/adversary.md.
gates.fail_condition: Not applicable: a census must not be reported as PASS or FAIL.
gates.observable: The rate/class census and the bounded-adversary statement.
gates.negative_control: Do not report a census as PASS.
gates.status_reason: Census only; the bounded-adversary statement exists at docs/src/spec/adversary.md, and the census is not a pass/fail verdict.
gates.does_not_claim: This criterion cannot go green by construction.

gates.title: Private-chain surface: live B/C/D read-only phase diagnosis
gates.pass_condition: A read-only B/C/D GET /health and GET /api/v1/status/operator snapshot with the phase discriminator, block-6 disposition, height gap, fault latch and isolation, each PASS/FAIL/PRECONDITION.
gates.fail_condition: A contradictory observation; an unmodelled diagnosis; an orphan body; a missing field treated as PASS.
gates.observable: The phase-diagnosis table classification, the operator gate keys, the block-6 disposition, the height gap, and the readiness/fault/isolation consistencies.
gates.negative_control: A pre-fix host lacking a field is PRECONDITION; 'block 6 unknown', a JSON 'unaccepted'/'unfinalized' disposition, and an 'issue #6 accepted' line must not be a PASS; a later orphan must override an earlier accepted; a contradictory ready/reason pair must FAIL.
gates.status_reason: Aria's 16 Nov read-only observation reaches four instances on two SSH hosts, but the installed build returns 404 for /api/v1/status/operator and the file logs are not a structured block-6 disposition. The collector must be run by the operator with a local plan.
gates.does_not_claim: The collector has not run live; the old build is not a current-build gate.

gates.title: Self-replay recovery and section-6 lockstep acceptance
gates.pass_condition: The selected release, every validator in lockstep (or a coordinated new genesis), an independent category-A verdict, and the owner-approved reconstructed trace with the reviewer's explicit acceptance.
gates.fail_condition: A mixed-version rollout, a self-authored or unpinned verdict, or a reconstructed trace without both acceptances.
gates.observable: The acceptance record's shape, derived lockstep/mixed-version, the selected pins, the independence attestation, the verdict URL and digest, and the reconstructed-trace decision.
gates.negative_control: A mixed-version activation span must fail; a self-authored review must fail; a reconstructed trace without the owner's decision URL or the reviewer's acceptance must FAIL (with --require-original-trace it is PRECONDITION); a record with no declared lockstep window is PRECONDITION.
gates.status_reason: No selected release lockstep campaign, independent category-A verdict, or reconstructed-trace acceptance exists. The #584 candidate/GO is a related live arm, not C357 closure.

related.criterion: C357 acceptance is a narrow hardfork boundary, not the M6 reproducibility review
the #584 verdict is a live-run sign-off, not the C357 lockstep acceptance

gates.does_not_claim: The acceptance checker validates a record; it does not prove a campaign ran.

gates.title: Populated-store migration and replay qualification
gates.pass_condition: An exact-format populated-store copy/rollback/restart acceptance, including replay qualification, before a store swap.
gates.fail_condition: A populated store is swapped without an exact-format copy/rollback/restart acceptance or a replay qualification.
gates.observable: The copy/rollback/restart result and the replay verdict on the populated store.
gates.negative_control: A fresh-genesis run must not substitute for the populated-store arm.
gates.status_reason: No in-tree gate row or witness; the dependency is recorded but unqualified.

related.criterion: the populated-store migration is an M4 prerequisite

gates.does_not_claim: A fresh-genesis or debug-build run is not a populated-store migration.

gates.title: Checkpoint v3 (Law 117): fringeHeadersRoot sync-protocol rule
gates.pass_condition: A source-pinned replay/compatibility acceptance for checkpoint v3: a v2 and v3 node are not mixed across a cold join; the join input set is the v3 set; an absent root is the legitimate v2 statement.
gates.fail_condition: The rule remains prose-only with no row digest, per-candidate disposition or compatibility decision, or a v2/v3 cold join is mixed.
gates.observable: The checkpoint statement's fringeHeadersRoot, the joiner's verification, and the cold-join input set.
gates.negative_control: A v2/v3 cold-join mix must fail; a prose-only correction must not pass.
gates.status_reason: Prose-only correction; not in the 94-row inventory or a per-candidate disposition.

related.criterion: the v3 statement is a selected-candidate prerequisite

gates.does_not_claim: The prose correction is not an independent safety attestation.

gates.title: Merge fork rule (Law 115): trimmed conflict scope
gates.pass_condition: A source-pinned replay/compatibility acceptance for the trimmed conflict-scope rule; all validators upgrade in lockstep, or the owner records an accepted-history compatibility decision or coordinated new genesis.
gates.fail_condition: The widened-scope block is accepted by the trimmed rule without a compatibility decision, or the rule remains prose-only.
gates.observable: Block acceptance under the trimmed scope, the dependency closure, and the lockstep/continuation decision.
gates.negative_control: A widened-scope block must be rejected by the trimmed rule; a mixed-version node set must fail.
gates.status_reason: Prose-only correction; not in the 94-row inventory or a per-candidate disposition.

related.criterion: the trimmed rule is a selected-candidate prerequisite

gates.does_not_claim: The prose correction is not an independent safety attestation.
